basic_details.job_title: NTPC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 40 Manager, Deputy Manager Posts
basic_details.short_information: NTPC Limited, New Delhi, Delhi, has invited applications for 40 posts in 2 roles under Advt No. 18/26. The posts include Manager (Finance), Deputy Manager (Finance). The online application is open from 19 November 2026 to 3 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Offline through SBI pay-in-slip (A/C No. 30987919993, CAG branch, New Delhi, Code 09996) or online through Net banking/Debit Card/Credit Card.

age_limit.age_details: Varies by post - see the table below

qualification.education_qualification: CA/CMA (previously ICWA) with minimum 12 years (Manager) or 10 years (Deputy Manager) of post-qualification executive experience in Accounts/Finance/Internal Audit

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: CA/CMA (previously ICWA); minimum 12 years of post-qualification executive experience (excluding training/trainee period, if any) in the area of Accounts/Finance/Internal Audit or combination thereof. Experience required: Minimum 12 years of post-qualification executive experience (excluding training/trainee period, if any) in Accounts/Finance/Internal Audit or combination thereof; Govt/PSU candidates need minimum 03 years in the pay-scale of Rs 70000-200000 or above (IDA E4 grade or above of NTPC effective from 01.01.2017) or equivalent scale, and an NOC. Age limit: Maximum 42 years. Pay: E5 Grade/IDA (Rs. 80000 – 220000 ). salary_details.pay_scale: E5 Grade/IDA Rs. 80000-220000 (Manager); E4 Grade/IDA Rs. 70000-200000 (Deputy Manager)

exam_pattern.details: Management reserves right to conduct multi-stage selection process

how_to_apply: Log on to careers.ntpc.co.in; only online applications are accepted.
Keep a valid email ID for the application.
Upload all listed documents while applying; incomplete documents are liable to rejection.
Pay Rs. 500 fee via SBI pay-in-slip (A/C No. 30987919993, CAG branch, New Delhi, Code 09996) or online if applicable.
Fill the journal number and branch code in the online form when paying at SBI.
Download the system-generated application slip; no document is to be sent by post.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: CA/CMA (previously ICWA); minimum 12 years of post-qualification executive experience (excluding training/trainee period, if any) in the area of Accounts/Finance/Internal Audit or combination thereof. Experience required: Minimum 12 years of post-qualification executive experience (excluding training/trainee period, if any) in Accounts/Finance/Internal Audit or combination thereof; Govt/PSU candidates need minimum 03 years in the pay-scale of Rs 70000-200000 or above (IDA E4 grade or above of NTPC effective from 01.01.2017) or equivalent scale, and an NOC. Age limit: Maximum 42 years. Pay: E5 Grade/IDA (Rs. 80000 – 220000 ). content_sections.heading: How Will NTPC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Application shortlisting/screening (if so required) Written/computer-based test (if so required) Personal interview (if so required) Medical examination by NTPC Medical Board/Officer before joining Management may conduct multi-stage selection: shortlisting/screening on qualification/percentage of marks, years of post-qualification experience etc. Management may raise minimum eligibility standards/criteria as per requirement Meeting minimum eligibility does not give a right to be shortlisted

content_sections.heading: NTPC Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Management reserves right to conduct multi-stage selection process

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Class X passing certificate/Marksheet, PAN Card and Aadhar Card Final Certificate of CA/CMA with all marksheets Caste/Disability certificate; OBC-NCL central format for FY 2026-27; EWS Income & Asset certificate for FY 2026-27 Experience documents in chronological order incl. Experience/Service certificate in NTPC sample format, 02 pay slips per year, Form-16 NOC from current employer (Govt/PSU candidates) Pay scale circular/matrix (Govt/PSU candidates)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NTPC Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Log on to careers.ntpc.co.in; only online applications are accepted. Keep a valid email ID for the application. Upload all listed documents while applying; incomplete documents are liable to rejection. Pay Rs. 500 fee via SBI pay-in-slip (A/C No. 30987919993, CAG branch, New Delhi, Code 09996) or online if applicable. Fill the journal number and branch code in the online form when paying at SBI. Download the system-generated application slip; no document is to be sent by post. Apply on or before 3 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Category once filled cannot be changed Vacancies may increase/decrease at the discretion of NTPC management Any addendum/corrigendum/updates will only be published on NTPC's website Canvassing in any form shall disqualify the candidate Disputes only under courts/tribunals/forums at Delhi

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NTPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 3 December 2026. Applications opened on 19 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NTPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 40 vacancies: 15 Manager (Finance), 25 Deputy Manager (Finance).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NTPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General/EWS/OBC: Rs. 500 (non-refundable). SC/ST/PwBD/XSM and female candidates: No fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Manager (Finance): maximum 42 years; Deputy Manager (Finance): maximum 40 years. Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC-NCL 3 years, PwBD 10 years, Ex-Serviceman As per Govt. guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: E5 Grade/IDA (Rs. 80000 – 220000 ) for Manager (Finance), E4 Grade/IDA (Rs. 70000 – 200000 ) for Deputy Manager (Finance).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: CA/CMA (previously ICWA) with minimum 12 years (Manager) or 10 years (Deputy Manager) of post-qualification executive experience in Accounts/Finance/Internal Audit. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian Nationals are eligible. All qualifications must be full-time from Universities/Institutions recognized and approved in India. Medical examination by NTPC Medical Board/Officer before joining; no relaxation in health standards.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Disability conditions 'likely to improve' under temporary disability are not eligible for reservation.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Application shortlisting/screening (if so required). Written/computer-based test (if so required). Personal interview (if so required). Medical examination by NTPC Medical Board/Officer before joining.
